name: Purpose & task
originalThought: QUELLE (Long 1862): 8.19 'Everything exists for some end'; 5.1 'I am rising to the work of a human being.' Everything has a purpose and a proper work.
softwareInterpretation: INTERPRETATION: Each unit (function/class/module) should serve one recognizable purpose (cohesion, single responsibility).
preconditions: A unit whose used foreign namespaces/imports and mixed layers are observable; naming conventions help.
limits: 'Responsibility' is a domain notion, not syntactic. Without context this is only a heuristic; coordination roles (facades/orchestrators) are legitimate.
counterexamples: A facade/orchestrator whose very purpose is coordination.
A DTO with many fields (many members != many responsibilities).
